## What landed

`exports/spine_export.py` (captures column + lane/upstream/view_original in `_evidence`), `exports/release_pages.py` (capture-history table + S-6 upstream on `evidence_page`), `exports/statements.py` (`capture_view_original`, `raw_href` machinery, §5.3 label extraction), `api/store.py` (`ClaimBinding`, `StoredClaim.bindings`, in-memory derivation), `api/store_pg.py` (bindings join + column guard; lane/p8 on capture meta), `api/models.py` (`ClaimEvidenceBinding`; `ClaimResponse.artifact_id/binding_status/evidence/provenance`; `EvidenceResponse.capture_classification/upstream`), `api/routes.py` (S-6-gated `source_uri` + `upstream` on public tier), `evidence/tiers.py` (lane/p8 fields; `capture_classification` in non-sealed rep), `web/src/lib/evidence-viewer.ts` (pane union + assert), `web/src/pages/evidence/[id].astro` (four-pane render), `web/src/lib/watch-evidence-fixture.ts` (lane/binding fields + derived-only + run-record views), tests (17 py + vitest).
